in_sanskrit.name: Gaffar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Pure, Trustworthy, Honest
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gaffar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Gaffar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gopa', meaning protector or cowherd. It is a name that signifies purity, trustworthiness, and honesty. It is a strong and wise name, often given to boys who are expected to be reliable and steadfast in their actions.
